title: I built an SPX model that estimates the closing center — today’s 3:30 PM estimate was 7752.5 vs. 7753.09 actual close
author: Markjxt-quant

comments.author: tradematesHQ
comments.body: 0.59 points off the close is impressive, but one good day doesn't make a model. The fact that you're showing the intraday misses too is the right call  -  cherry-picking one call is how you fool yourself. The real test is whether this holds up over weeks, not hours. Options positioning and dealer gamma are the right inputs, but they shift constantly. Post this again in a month with a track record, and people might actually engage. Right now, it's a screenshot and a story.

replies.author: Markjxt-quant
replies.body: The intraday data shown here updates every 30 minutes, including the expected range and closing-center estimate. I only consider buying a butterfly based on the final update, about 30 minutes before the close. The model is still in the testing stage, so I’ll keep tracking the results and posting updates over time.
